title: prefill/decode: kernel scheduling + KV cache + continuous batching optimizations (chunked/speculative/stage-overlap)
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Performance: Up to 18% tail-latency reduction and 12% throughput improvement for mixed prefill/decode workloads; ops: kernel scheduling and KV cache behavior improvements; no API changes.
body: Context: This PR implements a coordinated set of runtime optimizations to reduce end-to-end latency and improve throughput for mixed prefill+decode workloads. Motivation was regression observed in real workloads where long prefill sequences blocked decode streams and prevented continuous batching from achieving expected utilization. Work covers three complementary areas: 1) chunked prefill and speculative prefill to break long prefill sequences into decoder-friendly chunks and speculatively compute likely KV-cache states; falls back deterministically on mismatch. 2) stage-overlap scheduling so prefill, decode, and kernel dispatch can overlap on multi-GPU hosts. 3) kernel scheduler and KV cache enhancements to improve locality and reduce memory copy overheads. Summary of changes: - Prefill: introduce chunking logic (configurable chunk_size) and speculative-prefill path that performs lightweight attention-key precomputation ahead of confirmed tokens; falls back deterministically on mismatch. - Stage overlap: scheduler rework so prefill and decode stages are represented as fine-grained stages with explicit dependencies; kernel dispatcher can interleave kernels from different stages when resource ready. - Kernel scheduler: new micro-batching-aware prioritization that prefers latency-sensitive decode kernels while opportunistically filling GPU compute with prefill micro-tasks. - KV cache: compressed in-place KV cache move + pointer-based swapping to avoid full copies when speculative prefill is later confirmed; added correctness guards and metrics. - Continuous batching: improved batching window estimator that uses recent latency/sequence distribution to decide when to flush, plus backpressure hooks so long prefill-chunk flows don't block small decode requests. Benchmarks: On internal perf-cluster with LLaMA-2-13B quantized profile, we see median latency for 64-token prefill + 128-token decode decrease by ~12%, 95th percentile tail decrease by ~18%, and sustained throughput (requests/sec) increase ~10-12% under mixed traffic. Safety/Correctness: Added deterministic unit tests for speculative prefill fallback, property tests for KV cache invariants, and integration perf tests. CI: added new perf job that runs microbenchmarks for chunked prefill cases. Rollout plan: feature gated behind runtime flag (runtime.prefill_chunking=true), default disabled for Dedicated tenants until validated; gradual rollout to hosted customers with telemetry collection for mismatch rate. Related: ENG-2741 (prefill decode regressions), ENG-2819 (kv-cache memory regression).
commits: 6 commits: 1) prefill: add chunking and speculative prefill path (core/runtime/prefill); 2) scheduler: stage-overlap model and stage graph changes (core/runtime/scheduler); 3) kernel: micro-batching priority scheduler (core/runtime/kernel); 4) kv-cache: in-place pointer swap + compressed move (core/runtime/kv_cache); 5) continuous-batching: adaptive flush estimator + backpressure (core/runtime/batching); 6) tests/docs: unit/integration tests and runtime flag docs.
review_comments: Diego: 'Can we avoid extra branching in the hot path for decode-only requests?' Author: 'Yes, chunking path is bypassed early when request is decode-only; added an assertion and microbenchmark showing <1% overhead for decode-only flows.' Priya: 'Speculative prefill needs strong telemetry to ensure mismatch rates are low in hosted; add counters and automatic disable threshold.' Author: 'Added prefill_speculative_mismatch counter + config runtime.prefill_speculative_disable_threshold (default 0.02).' Ethan: 'KV pointer swap is clever but watch NUMA-locality; can we add an opt-out for hosts with known NUMA issues?' Author: 'Added runtime.prefill_numa_aware heuristic and unit tests; default is true only for hosts with >=2 NUMA nodes.' Diego (after changes): 'Approvals pending green CI and perf job result.' CI: perf job passed and regression thresholds met, Diego approved, Priya approved, Ethan approved.
ci_details: Checks: unit-tests (pass), integration-tests (pass), lint (pass), perf-job (pass, improved 10% throughput on mixed workload), e2e-smoke (pass). One transient flaky test flaky/test_scheduler_ordering was observed on first run and rerun fixed it.
notes_for_ops: Runtime flag runtime.prefill_chunking and runtime.prefill_speculative_disable_threshold added. Ops should monitor prefill_speculative_mismatch and prefill_chunk_hit_ratio metrics. Default gated; enable in canary before full rollout.
backwards_compatibility: No public API changes; all changes behind runtime flags; state migration for KV cache is handled in-place on first access.
perf_summary: Internal benchmarks: 95p latency -18%, median -12%; throughput +10-12% on mixed prefill+decode traffic. Worst-case mismatch rate observed in perf tests <1.4%, with fallback cost <2% extra latency when mismatched.
testing_matrix: Local unit tests + integration tests + CI perf job + dedicated perf cluster runs across quantized 7B/13B/70B-ish profiles. All green at time of merge.
notes: Follow-ups: 1) consider kernel fusion opportunities for common prefill-decoder kernel sequences (ENG-2890); 2) expose prefill chunking stats in console; 3) evaluate optimistic speculative width for larger models.
changelog_entry: Prefill/Decode runtime improvements: chunked and speculative prefill, kernel scheduling prioritization, KV cache in-place optimizations, and adaptive continuous batching. Improves latency and throughput for mixed workloads. Feature gated behind runtime.prefill_chunking.
